title: XRD (111) peak shift under compressive strain
what: 4% strain shifts the (111) peak by +0.70° (from 39.85° to 40.55°)

reader_questions.question: By how many degrees 2θ does the (111) peak shift at 4% strain?
How many replicate XRD scans back each curve?
What physical change does shifting to higher 2θ indicate?
reader_questions.expected: Lattice d-spacing contraction under compressive strain.
